samui.name: Kitchens for holiday rental villas
samui.title: Planning a kitchen for a holiday rental villa on Koh Samui
samui.text: A rental kitchen is used by strangers every week. Plan it for easy cleaning, tough finishes and storage that guests understand at a glance.
meta: Holiday Rental Villa Kitchens Koh Samui | SamuiKitchens.com
How to plan a durable, easy-to-clean kitchen for a Koh Samui holiday rental villa: layout, finishes, storage and appliances guests understand.
sections: A kitchen in a holiday rental on Koh Samui works harder than one in a private home. Different guests cook in it every week, cleaners reset it between stays, and the owner is often abroad. The best rental kitchens are simple to understand, quick to clean and hard to damage.
Choose a layout guests understand

Guests should find the sink, hob, fridge and bin within seconds. An L-shaped or island layout with a clear work triangle works well in most villas in Chaweng, Bophut and Lamai. Avoid hidden corners and complicated pull-outs that guests may force or break.
Specify finishes that forgive mistakes

Matte laminate or lacquer fronts hide fingerprints better than high gloss. Quartz worktops resist stains from curry, wine and coffee. Choose edge banding and hinges that cope with salt air from the Gulf, and avoid raw timber close to the sink.
Plan storage for a full house

Count plates, glasses and cutlery for the maximum number of guests, then add 30 percent. Deep drawers are easier than cupboards for guests to use. Leave a lockable owner's cupboard for spare linen, cleaning stock and personal items.
Make cleaning fast between stays

Handle-less fronts with a recessed profile, an integrated bin system and a backsplash without grout lines all cut cleaning time. Your housekeeping team will thank you, and reviews often mention a spotless kitchen.
Send us your rental brief

Tell us how many guests the villa sleeps, how often it is let and who manages it on the island. We will propose a layout and materials that suit the rental, and coordinate measurement and installation with your property manager.

samui.name: Worktops for a humid island
samui.title: Choosing a kitchen worktop for Koh Samui's humid climate
samui.text: Quartz, granite, compact laminate or solid wood? How each worktop copes with heat, humidity and salt air on the island.
meta: Kitchen Worktops for Humid Climates | SamuiKitchens.com
Quartz, granite, compact laminate or wood: how each kitchen worktop copes with Koh Samui's heat, humidity and salt air, and where each one works best.
sections: The worktop takes more punishment than any other part of the kitchen. On Koh Samui it also has to cope with high humidity for most of the year and heavy rain between October and December. Here is how the main options compare.
Quartz

Engineered quartz is non-porous, so it does not absorb water, oil or spices. It is the most practical choice for busy family homes and rental villas. Use trivets for very hot pans and keep it out of strong direct sun on outdoor counters.
Granite and natural stone

Granite handles heat well and suits outdoor and semi-outdoor kitchens. It needs sealing because it is slightly porous. Marble looks beautiful but etches with lime and vinegar, so we usually suggest it for low-use areas such as a bar.
Compact laminate
Compact laminate is thin, waterproof and strong, with a solid core that does not swell. It is a good value choice for condo kitchens and rental units, and it allows slim modern edges.
Solid wood
Teak and other hardwoods bring warmth, but they move with humidity and need oiling. We recommend wood for an island top or breakfast bar rather than around the sink and hob.
Get samples before you decide
Look at samples in daylight in your own home. Tell us how you cook and whether the kitchen opens to a terrace, and we will suggest two or three worktops that suit both the look and the climate.

samui.name: Ventilation in tropical kitchens
samui.title: Kitchen ventilation for open-plan tropical homes
samui.text: Open living spaces need a hood that really works. How to plan extraction, airflow and air-conditioning around your Koh Samui kitchen.
meta: Kitchen Ventilation for Tropical Homes | SamuiKitchens.com
How to plan a cooker hood, airflow and air-conditioning for an open-plan kitchen in a Koh Samui villa, so cooking smells and moisture stay under control.
sections: Most new villas on Koh Samui have open-plan kitchens that flow into the living room and terrace. That is wonderful for entertaining, but cooking smells, steam and grease travel quickly. Good ventilation is part of the kitchen design, not an afterthought.
Ducted extraction is best

A ducted hood that vents outside removes heat, steam and smells. Recirculating hoods only filter grease and odour, and they return humid air to the room. Plan the duct route early, before ceilings and beams are finished.
Size the hood to the hob

The hood should be at least as wide as the hob, and wider over an island. Island hoods need more extraction power because there are no walls to guide the air. Quiet motors matter in open living spaces.
Balance it with air-conditioning

A strong hood pulls air out of the room. If the villa is sealed and air-conditioned, make sure fresh air can come in, or the hood will struggle and doors may whistle. We coordinate this with your air-conditioning contractor.
Protect cabinets from steam

Use moisture-resistant boards and sealed edges near the hob and dishwasher. Leave a gap above tall appliances so heat can escape, and avoid placing wall cabinets directly beside the hood where steam collects.
Plan it with the layout
Send us your floor plan with ceiling heights and any beams. We will show the hood position, duct route and cabinet layout together so the kitchen works on the day it is installed.

samui.name: Outdoor kitchens on Koh Samui
samui.title: Outdoor kitchens on Koh Samui: what to plan before you build
samui.text: Grills, sinks and bars by the pool are part of island life. Plan shelter, materials and drainage so your outdoor kitchen lasts.
meta: Outdoor Kitchens Koh Samui: Planning Guide | SamuiKitchens.com
Plan an outdoor kitchen on Koh Samui: shelter from sun and rain, weatherproof materials, drainage, power and gas, so your poolside kitchen lasts.
sections: An outdoor kitchen by the pool or on a sala is one of the most popular additions to villas on Koh Samui. It is also the part of the house most exposed to sun, salt and monsoon rain, so planning matters even more than indoors.
Start with shelter

A roof or deep overhang protects the grill, the cabinets and the cook. Check where rain blows in during storms and where the afternoon sun hits. Even weatherproof materials last longer when they are not soaked every day.
Use materials made for outdoors
Choose marine-grade stainless steel, compact laminate or stone-clad carcasses, and granite or sintered stone worktops. Standard indoor boards and hinges will swell and rust quickly in the open air.
Plan water, drainage and power
A sink needs a drain that copes with heavy rain as well as daily use. Outdoor sockets must be weatherproof and on a safety circuit. If you use gas, plan a ventilated space for the bottle.
Think about how you entertain
Decide whether guests sit at a bar, at a dining table or around the pool. A bar counter facing the view, a fridge for drinks and enough landing space beside the grill make the space easy to use.
Share photos of the site
Send photos of the terrace, the orientation and any roof structure. We will suggest a layout and materials suited to the exact spot, from Choeng Mon to Taling Ngam.

samui.name: Kitchen project timeline
samui.title: From first brief to installed kitchen: a Koh Samui timeline
samui.text: What happens at each stage of a custom kitchen project on the island, and how to keep your schedule on track.
meta: Kitchen Project Timeline Koh Samui | SamuiKitchens.com
The stages of a custom kitchen project on Koh Samui, from brief and measurement to production, ferry delivery and installation, and how to keep it on schedule.
sections: Owners often ask how long a custom kitchen takes. The honest answer depends on decisions, site readiness and logistics. These are the stages of a typical project on Koh Samui and what you can do to keep each one moving.
Brief and concept

We start with your floor plan, photos and how you cook. From this we prepare a layout and a first selection of finishes. The faster decisions are made at this stage, the faster everything else follows.
Site measurement
Final drawings need exact measurements, taken once walls, floors and window openings are finished. Water, drainage and electrical points should be in their final positions, or clearly marked.
Approval and production
Once drawings, finishes and appliances are approved, production can start. Changes after approval usually add time, so check appliance model numbers and handle choices carefully.
Delivery to the island
Materials and finished cabinets reach Koh Samui by car ferry. We plan deliveries around weather and site access, and agree a dry, secure space on site to store the kitchen before installation.
Installation and handover

Installation includes fitting cabinets, worktops, appliances and final adjustments. We finish with a walkthrough so you know how everything works. Tell us your target date early and we will plan backwards from it.

samui.name: Island or peninsula?
samui.title: Island or peninsula: which suits your Koh Samui home?
samui.text: Both add worktop and seating. The right choice depends on room width, walkways and how you want to connect with the living space.
meta: Kitchen Island or Peninsula? | SamuiKitchens.com
Island or peninsula kitchen? Compare space needs, walkways, seating and cost to choose the right layout for your Koh Samui villa or home.
sections: Islands and peninsulas both add worktop, storage and a place to sit. On Koh Samui, where kitchens often open onto living rooms and terraces, the choice shapes how the whole space works.
How much space do you need?
An island needs clear walkways on every side, usually around one metre or more. A peninsula is attached to a wall or a run of cabinets, so it needs walkways on fewer sides and fits narrower rooms.
How do you entertain?

An island lets people gather all around it and works well in large open-plan villas. A peninsula creates a natural divide between cooking and living areas, which suits homes where guests sit at the counter while you cook.
Services and appliances

A sink or hob in an island needs water, drainage, power and possibly ventilation brought through the floor. A peninsula can often take these from the adjoining wall, which can make installation simpler.
Cost and storage
Both add cabinets, but an island usually needs more finished sides and a larger worktop. A peninsula can be a cost-effective way to gain storage and seating in a smaller kitchen.
See both options on your plan
Send us your room dimensions and we will sketch both an island and a peninsula option, with walkways marked, so you can choose with confidence.

samui.name: Kitchen lighting ideas
samui.title: Kitchen lighting for warm island evenings
samui.text: Layered lighting makes a kitchen practical for cooking and relaxed for dinner. How to plan task, ambient and accent light.
meta: Kitchen Lighting Ideas | SamuiKitchens.com
Plan layered kitchen lighting for a Koh Samui home: task lights over worktops, pendants over the island and soft accent light for warm island evenings.
sections: Daylight floods most Koh Samui kitchens, but evenings arrive early in the tropics. A good lighting plan lets you cook safely at seven and enjoy a relaxed dinner at nine, without switching between harsh and dark.
Task lighting first
Under-cabinet LED strips light the worktop where you chop and prepare. Place them towards the front of the cabinet so light falls on the work surface, not just on the backsplash.
Pendants over the island
Pendants define the island and bring light to the seating area. Hang them so they do not block the view across the room, and choose woven or glass shades that suit a tropical interior.
Ambient and accent light
Soft light under the plinth, inside glass cabinets or along open shelves adds warmth in the evening. Dimmers let you move from cooking to dining without turning everything off.
Choose warm, efficient LEDs
Warm white LEDs feel relaxed and run cool, which matters in a hot climate. Use fittings rated for kitchens, especially near the hob and sink.
Plan lighting with the cabinets
Lighting is easiest to install when it is designed together with the cabinets. Tell us how you use the kitchen at night and we will include a lighting plan in your drawings.

phuket.name: Condo kitchen renovation
phuket.title: Renovating a condo kitchen in Phuket: rules, timing and planning
phuket.text: Condo buildings have their own rules for noise, lifts and working hours. Plan around them and your renovation runs smoothly.
meta: Condo Kitchen Renovation Phuket | Phuket Kitchens
How to renovate a condo kitchen in Phuket: building rules, working hours, lift bookings, plumbing limits and a realistic plan for your project.
sections: Many Phuket kitchen projects take place in condominiums in Patong, Kata, Kamala and around Bang Tao. A condo renovation follows the same design steps as a villa, but the building adds its own rules. Knowing them early saves weeks.
Check the building rules first

Most juristic offices set working hours, quiet days and rules for noisy work such as cutting and drilling. Some require a deposit, a written work plan and the names of the installers. Ask for these documents before you finalise dates.
Book lifts and parking
Cabinets and worktops arrive in large pieces. Book the service lift and a loading space in advance, and check the size of the lift car and corridors so long worktops can actually reach your unit.
Work with the plumbing you have

In a condo, drains and risers usually cannot move far. Keep the sink close to its existing position and plan the dishwasher beside it. Moving the hob may need new electrical circuits approved by the building.
Make the most of a compact plan

Straight, galley and L-shaped layouts suit most condo kitchens. Tall units, deep drawers and a pull-out pantry add storage without crowding the room. Light fronts and under-cabinet lighting make a small kitchen feel larger.
Send us your unit plan
Share the floor plan, building name and photos. We will check access, propose a layout and plan installation days that fit the building's rules.

phuket.name: Cabinet materials for sea air
phuket.title: Cabinet materials that last in Phuket's sea air
phuket.text: Humidity and salt are hard on kitchens near the Andaman coast. Choose boards, fronts and hardware that will still look good in ten years.
meta: Kitchen Cabinet Materials for Sea Air | Phuket Kitchens
Which kitchen cabinet boards, fronts, hinges and handles last best in Phuket's humid, salty sea air, and how to protect your kitchen for the long term.
sections: Homes near the beaches of Phuket are exposed to humid, salty air all year and to heavy rain during the southwest monsoon. Ordinary cabinets can swell, peel or rust. The right materials make the difference between a kitchen that ages well and one that needs replacing.
Moisture-resistant boards

Choose moisture-resistant particle board, MDF or marine plywood for carcasses, especially around the sink and dishwasher. All exposed edges should be sealed with good edge banding so water cannot reach the core.
Durable fronts
Laminate, PU lacquer and acrylic fronts all perform well when they are properly sealed. Natural veneers bring warmth but need careful finishing. Avoid unsealed timber near water.
Hardware that does not rust

Hinges, runners and handles should be rated for humid environments. Stainless steel and quality coated hardware last much longer than cheap plated parts, which can corrode within a few seasons near the sea.
Ventilation and daily care
A kitchen that dries out is a kitchen that lasts. Use the hood when cooking, leave cabinet doors open briefly after cleaning and fix leaks quickly. Air-conditioning also keeps humidity under control.
Ask for samples
We can show board, front and hardware samples suited to coastal homes. Tell us how close you are to the sea and how the kitchen is used, and we will recommend the right specification.

phuket.name: Kitchen layouts for pool villas
phuket.title: Kitchen layouts for Phuket pool villas
phuket.text: Open-plan living, terraces and entertaining shape the best villa kitchens. Compare islands, peninsulas and indoor-outdoor layouts.
meta: Pool Villa Kitchen Layouts Phuket | Phuket Kitchens
Choose the right kitchen layout for a Phuket pool villa: islands, peninsulas, open-plan and indoor-outdoor kitchens that suit entertaining and family life.
sections: Pool villas in Phuket, from the hills above Kamala to the estates around Laguna and Nai Harn, are built for relaxed indoor-outdoor living. The kitchen is often the centre of that life, so its layout matters.
The island kitchen

An island is the most popular choice for open-plan villas. It gives a large prep surface, seating for family and guests, and a clear view across the living room to the pool. Allow generous walkways around it.
The peninsula
A peninsula works when the room is narrower or when you want a gentle divide between cooking and living. Bar seating on the living side keeps guests close without crowding the cook.
Indoor-outdoor kitchens
Many villa owners add an outdoor kitchen or bar by the pool. Plan the indoor kitchen so the route to the terrace is short and clear, with a fridge and storage for outdoor dining near the door.
A separate prep kitchen
In larger villas, a small back kitchen hides washing up and cooking smells, keeping the main kitchen clean for entertaining. It is especially useful for villas with staff or private chefs.
Plan the layout with us
Send us your villa plan and tell us how you entertain. We will propose layout options with walkways and seating marked, so you can compare them easily.

phuket.name: Storage for rental villas
phuket.title: Kitchen storage for Phuket rental villas
phuket.text: Rental guests need to find everything fast, and owners need space they can lock. How to plan storage that works for both.
meta: Rental Villa Kitchen Storage Phuket | Phuket Kitchens
Plan kitchen storage for a Phuket rental villa: easy-to-find drawers for guests, lockable owner storage and durable fittings that survive busy seasons.
sections: A rental villa kitchen has two kinds of users: guests who stay for a week and owners or managers who look after the property. Good storage keeps both happy and reduces breakages and complaints.
Drawers instead of deep cupboards
Wide drawers let guests see everything at a glance. Put plates, glasses and cutlery in the top drawers nearest the dishwasher, and pots and pans in deep drawers below the hob.
Label-free logic
Group items by task: coffee and tea near the kettle, cooking tools near the hob, cleaning supplies under the sink. Guests should not need to open every cabinet to find a corkscrew.
Lockable owner storage
Include at least one lockable tall cabinet for spare linen, cleaning stock, extra crockery and personal items. Property managers can restock between stays without guests having access.
Durable fittings
Rental kitchens open and close thousands of times a season. Choose soft-close runners and hinges with a strong load rating, and fronts that are easy to wipe clean.
Tell us how many guests you host
Share the number of bedrooms and typical guest numbers. We will plan storage volumes and an owner's cabinet that suit your rental.

phuket.name: A monsoon-proof kitchen
phuket.title: Protecting your kitchen during Phuket's monsoon season
phuket.text: Months of rain and high humidity test every kitchen. Simple design choices and habits keep cabinets dry and hardware working.
meta: Monsoon-Proof Kitchen Tips Phuket | Phuket Kitchens
How to protect kitchen cabinets, worktops and appliances during Phuket's monsoon season, with design choices and simple habits that prevent damp damage.
sections: From around May to October, the southwest monsoon brings frequent rain and very high humidity to Phuket. Kitchens in villas left empty for weeks are especially at risk. A few design choices and habits prevent most problems.
Raise and seal the base
Use adjustable plastic legs and a sealed plinth so cabinets stay clear of mopping water and minor leaks. Seal the underside and back of base units, not just the visible surfaces.
Keep air moving

Damp, still air causes mould. A ducted hood, an air-conditioning or dehumidifier schedule and small ventilation gaps behind tall units all help. If the villa is empty, ask your manager to run air-conditioning regularly.
Watch the sink area
Most water damage starts at the sink. Choose a sealed undermount or integrated sink, a waterproof base under it and quality silicone around the worktop joints.
Protect appliances
Use surge protection for built-in appliances, as storms can cause power spikes. Leave the fridge door slightly open if it is switched off while the villa is empty.
Plan for the climate from day one
When we design a kitchen in Phuket, we specify boards, seals and hardware for the wet season. Ask us about climate-ready options for your project.

phuket.name: Choosing built-in appliances
phuket.title: Choosing built-in appliances for your Phuket kitchen
phuket.text: Ovens, hobs, hoods and fridges shape the cabinets around them. Decide early and the kitchen fits perfectly on installation day.
meta: Built-In Kitchen Appliances Guide | Phuket Kitchens
How to choose built-in ovens, hobs, hoods, fridges and dishwashers for a Phuket kitchen, and why appliance decisions must come before final cabinet drawings.
sections: Built-in appliances give a kitchen a clean, finished look, but every model has its own dimensions and installation needs. Choosing them early is the single best way to avoid delays and last-minute changes.
Hob and hood
Induction hobs are efficient, easy to clean and add less heat to the room, which matters in a tropical climate. Match the hood width to the hob and plan a ducted route outside where possible.
Ovens and steam ovens
A tall oven housing at eye level is easier to use than an oven under the hob. A combination steam oven is popular for healthy cooking and can replace a microwave.
Fridges and freezers

Integrated fridges disappear behind cabinet fronts, while freestanding American-style fridges need a wide space with ventilation. In hot climates, leave enough air space so the compressor works efficiently.
Dishwasher and laundry
Place the dishwasher next to the sink for easy plumbing. In smaller homes and condos, we can also integrate a washing machine or dryer into the kitchen design.
Send us your appliance list
Share model numbers or links for your chosen appliances. We design the cabinets around their exact sizes, so everything fits on installation day.

phuket.name: Small kitchen ideas
phuket.title: Small kitchen ideas for Phuket apartments
phuket.text: A compact kitchen can still be beautiful and practical. Layout, storage and lighting ideas for apartments and studios.
meta: Small Apartment Kitchen Ideas Phuket | Phuket Kitchens
Make a small apartment kitchen in Phuket work harder: compact layouts, tall storage, slim appliances, light colours and lighting ideas that add space.
sections: Studios and one-bedroom apartments in Phuket Town, Patong and Rawai often have compact kitchens along one wall or in a corner. With careful planning, a small kitchen can do almost everything a large one can.
Choose the right layout
A straight or galley kitchen makes the most of narrow rooms. An L-shaped kitchen fits corners and can include a small breakfast ledge. Keep the work triangle short and uncluttered.
Build up, not out
Tall cabinets to the ceiling add storage without taking floor space. Use the top shelves for items you rarely need, and keep everyday items between hip and shoulder height.
Slim and integrated appliances
A 60 cm or even 45 cm dishwasher, a two-zone induction hob and a combination microwave oven save space. Integrated fridges keep the kitchen looking calm and uncluttered.
Light colours and good lighting
Light fronts and worktops reflect daylight, while under-cabinet LEDs light the worktop at night. Handle-less fronts keep the look simple and the walkway clear.
Make every centimetre count
Send us your room measurements. We will design a compact kitchen with storage planned to the centimetre.

pattaya.name: Renovating from Bangkok
pattaya.title: Renovating your Pattaya kitchen while living in Bangkok
pattaya.text: Many Pattaya owners live in Bangkok or abroad. How to run a kitchen project remotely with fewer site visits and no surprises.
meta: Remote Kitchen Renovation Pattaya | Pattaya Kitchens
How to renovate a Pattaya condo or villa kitchen while living in Bangkok or abroad: remote briefs, approvals and installation with fewer site visits.
sections: A large share of Pattaya homes belong to owners who live in Bangkok or overseas and visit at weekends or in the holidays. A kitchen renovation can still run smoothly if the project is planned for remote decisions.
Start with a remote brief
Send floor plans, photos of every wall, appliance links and pictures of kitchens you like. A short video call is often enough to agree the layout direction before anyone visits the site.
One measurement visit
Final drawings need exact measurements. We arrange one site visit with your building manager or caretaker, so you only need to authorise access, not be there in person.
Approve from anywhere
Drawings, finish samples photographed in daylight and a clear written specification let you approve the design from Bangkok. Keep decisions in one message thread so nothing gets lost.
Plan installation around your trips
Book installation for weekdays and schedule the handover for a weekend visit. We send progress photos during installation so you know exactly where the project stands.
Tell us when you are next in Pattaya
Share your travel dates and we will plan the project timeline around them, from Jomtien to Naklua and East Pattaya.

pattaya.name: High-rise condo kitchens
pattaya.title: Kitchen design for Pattaya high-rise condos
pattaya.text: Sea views, compact plans and strict building rules. How to design a condo kitchen that feels spacious and installs without problems.
meta: High-Rise Condo Kitchen Design Pattaya | Pattaya Kitchens
Kitchen design ideas for Pattaya high-rise condos: compact layouts, sea-view orientation, storage, building rules and delivery planning for tower installations.
sections: Pattaya's skyline is full of condominium towers along Beach Road, Wong Amat, Pratumnak and Jomtien. Their kitchens are usually compact and open to the living room, often with a balcony and sea view nearby.
Design with the view
In an open-plan unit, the kitchen is part of the living space. Handle-less fronts, integrated appliances and a calm colour palette keep the focus on the view rather than on cabinets.
Use every wall
Straight and L-shaped kitchens suit most condo plans. Tall storage to the ceiling, a corner carousel and a pull-out pantry add capacity without taking floor space.
Breakfast bar instead of a table
A slim peninsula or counter extension gives a place to eat and work while keeping the living area open. Bar stools tuck away underneath when not in use.
Plan the delivery
Long worktops and tall units must fit in the service lift and corridors. We check lift sizes and building rules before production, and book delivery slots with the juristic office.
Share your unit plan
Send the building name, unit plan and photos. We will propose a layout that suits the space and the building's installation rules.

pattaya.name: Finishes for sun and heat
pattaya.title: Kitchen finishes for sunny, west-facing Pattaya homes
pattaya.text: Strong afternoon sun can fade and warp the wrong materials. Choose fronts, worktops and blinds that stay looking new.
meta: Kitchen Finishes for Sun and Heat | Pattaya Kitchens
Choose kitchen fronts, worktops and window treatments that cope with strong afternoon sun and heat in west-facing Pattaya condos and villas.
sections: Many Pattaya condos and villas face west towards the sea, which means beautiful sunsets and strong afternoon sun on the kitchen. UV light and heat can fade colours, yellow some plastics and warm dark worktops.
UV-stable fronts
Quality laminates, PU lacquers and acrylic fronts with UV-stable finishes hold their colour better than cheap foils. Ask for samples and compare them in daylight in your own home.
Worktops in the sun
Quartz is practical for everyday use, but some colours can change under constant direct sun. Sintered stone and granite are more UV-resistant, which suits kitchens beside large windows or terraces.
Colour choices
Very dark fronts and worktops absorb heat and show dust. Mid-tones, natural wood looks and warm whites stay cooler to the touch and look fresh for longer in bright rooms.
Control the light
Blinds, tinted glass or a deep balcony overhang protect both the kitchen and the cook. Plan window treatments together with the kitchen layout so they do not clash with wall cabinets.
Tell us which way your kitchen faces
Send photos taken in the afternoon and we will suggest finishes that suit the light in your home.

pattaya.name: Open-plan villa kitchens
pattaya.title: Open-plan kitchens for pool villas in East Pattaya
pattaya.text: Villas in East Pattaya and Huay Yai are built for family life and entertaining. How to plan an open kitchen that connects to the pool.
meta: Open-Plan Villa Kitchens East Pattaya | Pattaya Kitchens
Plan an open-plan kitchen for a pool villa in East Pattaya or Huay Yai: islands, dining zones, storage and indoor-outdoor flow for family life and guests.
sections: East Pattaya, Huay Yai and Bang Saray are home to many pool villas for families and weekend visitors from Bangkok. These homes usually have a large open living space where the kitchen, dining area and lounge flow towards the pool.
Zone the space
Even in an open plan, a kitchen works best with clear zones: preparation, cooking, washing and serving. An island can separate the cook from guests while keeping everyone together.
Connect to the terrace
Place the fridge, glasses and serving space close to the terrace doors. Many owners add an outdoor bar or barbecue area, so plan a short, clear route between inside and outside.
Storage for family weekends
Weekend homes fill up with family and friends. Plan generous drawers, a pantry for bulk shopping and space for large platters and party equipment.
Easy to close up
When the villa is empty during the week, the kitchen should be easy to clean and leave. Integrated appliances, sealed worktops and durable fronts help.
Plan your villa kitchen
Send your villa plan and tell us how many people usually stay. We will propose a layout that suits both busy weekends and quiet weekdays.

pattaya.name: Where to spend your budget
pattaya.title: Kitchen budgets: where to spend and where to save
pattaya.text: Not every part of a kitchen needs the top specification. Put your budget where it lasts and save where it does not show.
meta: Kitchen Budget Guide: Spend vs Save | Pattaya Kitchens
Where to spend and where to save on a new kitchen in Pattaya: carcasses, hardware, worktops, fronts and appliances, explained for condos and villas.
sections: Every kitchen has a budget, whether it is a rental condo in Jomtien or a family villa in East Pattaya. The best kitchens put money into the parts that work hardest and save on the parts that are easy to upgrade later.
Spend on what you touch every day
Drawer runners, hinges and the worktop are used thousands of times a year. Quality hardware and a durable worktop are worth the investment because they are expensive to replace.
Spend on the carcass
Moisture-resistant boards and sealed edges protect the kitchen from humidity. Cheap carcasses can swell within a few years, especially around the sink.
Save on decorative extras
Open shelving, decorative panels and statement lighting can be added or changed later. Start with a solid kitchen and add details over time.
Choose appliances by use
If you cook every day, invest in a good hob and hood. For a rental or weekend home, reliable mid-range appliances are usually enough.
Ask for a range, not a single number
Every kitchen is quoted from its own plan. Send us your plan and priorities and we will give you a price range with options to adjust it.

pattaya.name: Galley and straight kitchens
pattaya.title: Galley and straight kitchens for compact Pattaya apartments
pattaya.text: Narrow kitchens can be the most efficient of all. How to plan a galley or one-wall kitchen that feels open and works hard.
meta: Galley & Straight Kitchens for Apartments | Pattaya Kitchens
Plan a galley or straight one-wall kitchen for a compact Pattaya apartment: walkway widths, storage, appliances and lighting that make a small kitchen work.
sections: Many apartments in central Pattaya, Naklua and Jomtien have narrow kitchens. A galley kitchen with two parallel runs, or a straight kitchen along one wall, is often the most efficient choice.
Get the walkway right
In a galley kitchen, leave enough space between the two runs to open the dishwasher and oven doors and pass behind the cook. Too narrow feels cramped; too wide means extra steps.
Plan the work order
Arrange the run in the order you cook: fridge, preparation space, sink, more preparation space, then hob. This keeps movement short and logical.
Storage on both sides
In a galley, use one side for tall storage and appliances and the other for the main worktop. In a straight kitchen, run wall cabinets or open shelves to the ceiling.
Keep it light
Light fronts, a pale worktop and continuous under-cabinet lighting make a narrow kitchen feel wider. Handle-less doors keep the walkway clear.
Send us your measurements
Share your room width and length and we will show you whether a galley or straight layout suits your apartment best.

pattaya.name: Easy-clean holiday home kitchens
pattaya.title: Easy-clean kitchens for Pattaya holiday homes
pattaya.text: Holiday homes and rentals need kitchens that clean up fast between guests. Materials and details that save housekeeping time.
meta: Easy-Clean Holiday Home Kitchens | Pattaya Kitchens
Design an easy-clean kitchen for a Pattaya holiday home or rental: wipeable fronts, seamless worktops, integrated sinks and storage that speeds up housekeeping.
sections: Holiday homes and short-stay rentals in Pattaya change guests often. A kitchen that cleans up quickly saves housekeeping time and keeps the property looking fresh in every listing photo.
Wipeable fronts
Matte laminate and anti-fingerprint finishes hide marks better than high gloss. Handle-less profiles have fewer edges for dirt to collect.
Seamless surfaces
Quartz or compact laminate worktops with an undermount or integrated sink leave no joints for dirt. A full-height backsplash panel is faster to clean than tiles with grout lines.
Built-in bins and storage
An integrated waste and recycling system under the sink keeps rubbish out of sight. Drawer organisers stop cutlery and utensils piling up after every stay.
Robust appliances
Choose appliances with simple controls guests understand. Induction hobs are fast to wipe clean and safer for rental guests.
Plan a rental-ready kitchen
Tell us how often the home is let and who cleans it. We will design a kitchen that is quick to turn around between guests.
